timeline.labelDe: Der Eiffelturm wird in Paris für die Weltausstellung 1889 errichtet

questions.cardDe: Wie heißt keines der Mainzelmännchen: Anton, Conni oder Fred?

questions.en: What is the name of the Mainzelmännchen whose name begins with F?

timeline.labelEn: The ZDF's Mainzelmännchen cartoon figures premiere
timeline.labelDe: Die Mainzelmännchen des ZDF haben Premiere

questions.notes: The six are Anton, Berti, Conni, Det, Edi and Fritzchen, so the card's answer is Fred. Reworked into an open question about the real F-name.

questions.en: What is the name of the most powerful ruler of the 13th century who, according to geneticists, is said to have 16 million descendants today?

timeline.labelEn: Genghis Khan, founder of the Mongol Empire (born c. 1155–1167, died 1227)
timeline.labelDe: Dschingis Khan, Begründer des Mongolischen Reiches (geboren um 1155–1167, gestorben 1227)

questions.notes: The estimate (about 16 million men) is not universally accepted (de.wikipedia). Birth year uncertain: c. 1155, 1162 or 1167.
